goals: Preserve a player's component-exact organization intent after a physical stack leaves an eligible persistent storage or machine slot.

Apply native insertion permission AND exact reservation admission to manual placement, vanilla QUICK_MOVE, hoppers, sided automation, and QSN without changing extraction, destination order, internal processing, or routing ownership.
Resolve every eligible logical menu slot to one stable block-owned or player-owned reservation holder, its physical local slot, physical stack, real slot count, and native admission result.

Retain Canary 3's user-approved alpha-only ghost visuals, literal zero, compact occupied marker, hover behavior, carried-shulker persistence, optional tooltip overlays, and server-authoritative public API.
Keep the supported-owner and menu policy intentionally exact rather than admitting arbitrary modded, temporary, fake, foreign, player-inventory, or entity containers.
scope: Maintain exact Minecraft Java 26.2 Fabric Canary 4 from implementation/artifact checkpoint d09c3f7153d4e53a36f41fb1ea80d85b4cb2e28f, physically verified in Test Slot A at manager revision 77.

Store sparse format-1 count-one ItemStackTemplate reservations per stable physical owner; requested block entities use only their real local slot range, vanilla and Double Barrels doubles retain two independent 27-slot owners, and the player Ender inventory is one player-owned 27-slot holder.

Support exact vanilla chest and trapped-chest families, barrel, undyed and all 16 dyed shulkers, dispenser, dropper, hopper, furnace, blast furnace, smoker, brewing stand, crafter, and PlayerEnderChestContainer.

Recognize ordinary and all eight unwaxed/waxed copper chest states through the authoritative predicate blockEntity.getType() == BlockEntityTypes.CHEST && BlockEntityTypes.CHEST.isValid(blockEntity.getBlockState()); single and permitted double forms keep exact physical-half ownership across oxidation, scraping, waxing, and unwaxing.

Preserve vanilla chest CompoundContainer ownership mapping and associate the exact optional Double Barrels 54-slot wrapper with its proven main and partner BarrelBlockEntity owners; combined slots 0-26 map to main local 0-26 and 27-53 to partner local 0-26.

Persist Ender Chest reservations on PlayerEnderChestContainer under container_slot_reservations:ender_chest_reservations adjacent to EnderItems, default old player data to empty, and restore the same player-owned holder across the Minecraft 26.2 respawn path independently of keepInventory.

Use a scoped native-admission bypass to query the actual owner's vanilla canPlaceItem policy, retain targeted post-native hooks for furnace-family, brewing, and crafter rules, preserve specialized menu Slot subclasses and callbacks, and never gate internal setItem writes.

Expose only exact supported storage slots in ChestMenu, ShulkerBoxMenu, DispenserMenu, HopperMenu, FurnaceMenu, BlastFurnaceMenu, SmokerMenu, BrewingStandMenu, and CrafterMenu snapshots/actions; player, hotbar, fake, inactive, result-inventory, and foreign slots remain excluded.

Keep getReservation, isReserved, reservationMatches, mayInsert, classify, and every ReservationSlotClass value binary-compatible with accepted CSR C1 consumers and QSN C8; native-non-writable reservations classify NON_WRITABLE and cannot create QSN affinity.

Preserve neutral 0x59FFFFFF alpha-only ghost rendering, the audited premultiplied pipeline, #43362A solely as the Matcha slot background, literal-zero placement/shadow, occupied marker, hover tooltip, reservation-free rendering, DataComponents.CONTAINER integrity, and Easy Shulker Boxes / Item Interactions overlays.
Record the user's exact Canary 3 visual observation only as a narrow INCONCLUSIVE result at manager revision 75; it is not a complete C3 matrix pass and supplies no C4 runtime evidence.
Retain the Stacks Are Stacks report as deferred; its project, artifact, stack-capacity semantics, deployment, and runtime status remain untouched.

exclusions: Decorated Pots, Jukeboxes, Chiseled Bookshelves, wood Shelves, Lecterns, Campfires, Composters, Suspicious Sand or Gravel, Vaults, crafting-table and temporary workstation inventories, Beacons, container entities, arbitrary modded containers, and every owner outside the exact allowlist.
Player inventory, hotbar, equipment, crafting/result inventory, Trinkets, trash, fake, inactive, temporary, foreign, and entity-backed slots.
Automatic sorting, item routing, destination selection, routing priority, dump-all behavior, restock quantities, cross-container templates, category or tag matching, and multiple identities per slot.
Changes to extraction, machine processing, sided rules, transfer cooldowns, comparator/drop/open-close behavior, stack limits, XP/result callbacks, or native menu layout and notifications.

Generic setItem interception, reservation-bearing drops for chests, barrels, machines, or Double Barrels, fake zero-count stacks, or mutation of DataComponents.CONTAINER; only the established shulker block-to-item reservation round trip persists.
Ender Chest block ownership, Ender Chest hopper access, Ender Chest QSN scanning, cross-player reservation sharing, or keepInventory-dependent durability.
Hard runtime dependencies, nested redistribution, or restrictive upper bounds for Double Barrels, Easy Shulker Boxes, or Item Interactions; optional seams fail closed when absent or changed.

Any Stacks Are Stacks workaround or change to projects/stacks-are-stacks-container-fixes, successor acceptance/promotion, inferred runtime evidence, Minecraft launch, or access to the protected 26.1.2 gameplay instance.
